notes: Recommended local models per hardware tier. Edit this file on GitHub to push new recommendations to every PostLens install (see README: Updating recommended models).

tiers.label: Standard
tiers.name: Qwen 3.5 9B
tiers.why: Strong all-rounder that fits an 8 GB graphics card. Supports 200+ languages, including Bangla.

tiers.label: Plus
tiers.name: Gemma 4 12B
tiers.why: Newer, larger model with a long context window, so it can read more of a page or site per answer.

tiers.label: Pro
tiers.name: Qwen 3.8 27B
tiers.why: The strongest free model in this catalog for detailed analysis. Needs a high-end graphics card or a Mac with lots of memory.
